description: The event catalog of module contracts v0.1 (docs/contracts/module-contract-v0.1.md, section 8). emitters: the capabilities (or the core) that may emit the type. subject: whether the envelope's subject is required, optional or absent.

types.summary: An enforcement point decided on a governed call or interaction, allowed or denied.
types.subject: required

types.summary: A governed call that was allowed has finished.
types.subject: required

types.summary: A module instance started and registered.
types.subject: optional

types.summary: An enforcement point applied a halt, layer by layer.
types.subject: required

types.summary: An enforcement point verified and activated a policy bundle.
types.subject: required

types.summary: An enforcement point refused a policy bundle and kept the previous one, if any.
types.subject: required

types.summary: An instance lost contact with the core for longer than its lease.
types.subject: optional

types.summary: A runtime-control module isolated a halted agent's workloads at the network level.
types.subject: required

types.summary: A runtime-control module removed a network quarantine after the halt was released.
types.subject: required

types.summary: An agent was proposed (lifecycle transition T1).
types.subject: required

types.summary: An agent changed lifecycle state (transitions T2 to T14).
types.subject: required

types.summary: A committee approved a policy version. The subject is the agent for agent-specific policies.
types.subject: optional

types.summary: Someone halted an agent, a selection of agents or the fleet. The subject is the agent for agent halts.
types.subject: optional

types.summary: A halt was released by two people, or automatically for a drill.
types.subject: optional

types.summary: The audit log signed a checkpoint (ADR-0006).
types.subject: none
